gigs.title: I will write an SEO-optimised blog post or article for your website
gigs.description:
Need fresh, engaging content that ranks? I write well-researched, SEO-friendly blog posts and articles tailored to your audience.

AI-assisted writing clearly disclosed. Every post is proofread, structured with H2/H3 headings, and written to hold readers' attention.

What you get:
✅ Chosen word count delivered on time
✅ Keyword-focused without keyword stuffing
✅ Engaging introduction and clear call-to-action
✅ One free revision

gigs.title: I will design a modern, minimalist logo for your brand
gigs.description:
First impressions matter. I create clean, memorable logos that look great everywhere — from business cards to billboard.

Generated using advanced AI image tools and refined for professional output. Clearly disclosed as AI-assisted design.

Deliverables:
✅ PNG with transparent background
✅ High-resolution file
✅ Colour and black-and-white versions
✅ One free revision

gigs.title: I will build a responsive one-page website with HTML and Tailwind CSS
gigs.description:
Need a clean, fast landing page without the agency price tag? I build responsive one-page websites ready to host anywhere.

Built with semantic HTML5 and Tailwind CSS. Mobile-first. No frameworks needed — just upload and go.

Includes:
✅ Fully responsive design
✅ Clean, commented code
✅ Contact section
✅ One free revision

gigs.title: I will write SEO-optimised website copy, meta tags, and keyword strategy
gigs.description:
Rank higher and convert better. I deliver a complete SEO copy package: meta title, meta description, target keywords, and a fully optimised page article.

Each piece is written to satisfy both search engines and real readers. No keyword stuffing.

Deliverables:
✅ Meta title (≤60 chars)
✅ Meta description (≤160 chars)
✅ 5 target keywords with rationale
✅ 800-word SEO article

gigs.title: I will create accurate SRT subtitle captions for your video
gigs.description:
Reach a wider audience and improve accessibility with accurate subtitles. I create SRT caption files compatible with YouTube, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and more.

Deliverables:
✅ SRT file (ready to upload)
✅ Accurate timestamps
✅ Clean punctuation and formatting
✅ One free revision

gigs.title: I will write engaging social media captions and posts for 5 platforms
gigs.description:
Stop staring at a blank screen. I write platform-native social media copy for Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok — all from one brief.

Each post is written in the platform's native voice and tone.

Deliverables:
✅ Twitter/X post (≤280 chars)
✅ Instagram caption + hashtag block
✅ LinkedIn professional post
✅ Facebook conversational post
✅ TikTok caption
✅ One free revision
